{{Quote|They have taken something of importance from the Empire&mdash;a piece of the ''weapons sysem'' for the new ''Death Star''. It would take months to rebuild the stolen piece. The Death Star is useless without it.|[[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]|<ref name="SWA" />}}
In approximately [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], a small [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] force '''ambushed''' an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]] on the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]], leading to the theft of a crucial component of the [[Death Star II/Legends|second]] [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star's]] weapons system.

==The skirmish==
The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Wolf Squadron]] ambushed an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]] passing near an [[Annamar asteroid field|asteroid field]] on the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]].<ref name="SWA" />

During the battle, [[Rebel trooper/Legends|Rebel troopers]] boarded the [[Imperial convoy ship|cargo ship]], killed its complement of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and steered the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] into the [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]], landing it in their [[Abandoned droid factory|secret base]] on [[Annamar]].<ref name="SWA" />
